title: Estimating Effects of Long-Term Treatments
authors: Shan Huang; Chen Wang; Yuan Yuan; Jinglong Zhao; Jing-Jing Zhang
eligible_reason: Methods paper on a longitudinal surrogate framework for estimating long-term treatment effects from short-term A/B tests. Empirical applications are two randomized WeChat experiments (Experiment_1/2 estimation.ipynb: linear surrogate model, VAR, Athey et al. surrogate index) plus synthetic experiments. Treatment is randomized at a single launch; no staggered adoption, no TWFE DiD.
design_notes: Python notebooks using statsmodels OLS/VAR/AutoReg on user-level experimental metrics; simulations generate synthetic treatment/control panels.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: randomized A/B tests with a single common launch; surrogate-index estimators, not DiD

data_files_note: README.md: the Experiment_1/2 notebooks 'cannot be executed because they lack the actual experimental data'; only simulated datasets for the synthetic experiments are shipped.
data_provenance_note: WeChat experimental data not shipped; the only shipped CSVs are synthetic simulation draws.
screener_notes: Screened from package README, notebooks and OpenAlex abstract. Not a near-miss.
